Who sees the ads

Buyers within 40 km, picked by where they work.

Ads only show to people in these towns and the city, and the wording changes by town. A Padra chemical-plant engineer sees "15 minutes from work". A Dabhoi family sees "move the family to Vadodara". Each green dot on the map is an enquiry arriving.

Padra~15 kmChemical and pharma plants, same road as the site
Por GIDC~13 kmFactory staff who want a city home
Waghodia~28 kmPharma and engineering estate
Karjan~30 kmGIDC on the highway to Bharuch
Dabhoi~32 kmTrader families moving up to the city
Savli~38 kmEngineering and rail plants
Anand~40 kmDairy, students' families, NRI parents
Distances are approximate road distances from the site.
The data · not a bought list

People who have bought here before, and are looking again.

Generic lists are full of people who will never buy a ₹60 lakh home. We start from households that already bought a new flat around Vadodara, then keep only the ones showing signs they are looking again.

Bought a new home here
1.2 lakh
Households in Vadodara district that bought into new projects registered 2017–2023.
Due to upgrade now
66,000
Of those, bought 2017–2019. Seven to nine years on, families have grown and loans are paid down.
Looking this year
6,600
If one in ten of them is house-hunting this year. These are the people the AI calls first.
Signal 1 · they bought before
  1. Registered sale records around Vadodara: who bought, in which society, when.
  2. Sunfin's own past clients and enquiries, the strongest list of all.
  3. Owners in older societies near Atladara, Padra and Por.
Signal 2 · they are looking now
  1. They enquired on another project or portal in the last 90 days.
  2. They clicked a Shree Namasya ad, opened the brochure or replied on WhatsApp.
  3. On the AI call they confirm budget, timing and a loan. Only then do they reach your team.
Estimate, not a guarantee. Basis: 2,149 residential and mixed projects approved on Gujarat RERA in Vadodara district 2017–2023 (1,155 of them 2017–2019), at a typical 64 homes each, 90% sold. New projects only; resale buyers and Anand district would add more. "One in ten looking" is our assumption.
Built around the team you already have

Your callers keep selling. The AI does the waiting and the sorting.

Shree Namasya · inbound team

Every enquiry answered

  1. The AI calls each new enquiry within a minute, in Gujarati, Hindi or English.
  2. It asks what your team asks: budget, loan, when they want to move, who decides.
  3. Ready buyers get a site visit booked on the call. Your team gets a short note before the visit.
  4. The not-ready ones get WhatsApp follow-ups and a call back in 30, 60 or 90 days, without anyone tracking it.
Your callers spend their day with buyers who already said yes to a visit.
Sunfin Realty · outbound team

A ready list every morning

  1. The AI goes through your old enquiries and new lists and calls every one of them first.
  2. It finds who is still looking, for which project, at what budget.
  3. At 9 am each caller gets their hot list, with the notes from each AI call.
  4. The same system runs for every project Sunfin sells, each with its own ads and script.
Your callers stop dialling numbers that never pick up.
